questions.question: The only open item is signing in to the example service. `example whoami` reports not logged in, and the login is interactive, so only you can complete it. What would you like to do?

options.label: H1: Sign in
options.description: You run `example login` yourself (in Claude Code, type `! example login` so the output lands in this session) and complete the interactive prompt.

options.label: Not now
options.description: Authorizes nothing; the sign-in stays open in the human lane.
